Toni (CSM): Heads up — CedarTech just signaled a new internal ML/Ops team spinning up. They want embeddings + chat for a search/workflow assistant across 3 product squads. Could be 2-3x current qps. Not urgent but likely expansion.
Sam (SE): Nice — do we have usage numbers or target latency/cost goals?
Toni (CSM): They currently use hosted API; ~1.2M tokens/day, peaks ~180 qps. They said target is <200ms p95 for chat and same-day search. Interested in predictable cost.
Alex (Account Exec): Renewal in 9 months — this is a good expansion angle. Can we get an initial estimate for Dedicated vs hosted scaling?
Sam (SE): Quick calc: at 3x tokens/day, hosted run-rate grows linearly; Dedicated could cut per-token by ~30-40% depending on quantization and batching. Need exact model mix though.
Iris (Enablement): I can run a 90-min enablement + prompt engineering workshop for their ML/Ops and search teams. Want to align on goals first.
Toni (CSM): They asked for onboarding help for model selection + routing rules. Also want advice on caching & embeddings refresh cadence.
OpsBot: ticket #CS-4829 created: "CedarTech — capacity assessment + pilot quota bump" <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4829>
Sam (SE): Can you share a sample config we might propose? e.g.:
```
route: cedartech-prod
model: giraffe-7b-q4
batching: dynamic
kv_cache: enabled
fallback: giraffe-7b-8bit
scaling: min_replicas:2, max_replicas:10
```
Toni (CSM): Perfect. I'll attach their current telemetry in the ticket and ask for a 2x temporary quota bump to run a week-long pilot.
Alex (Account Exec): I'll block 30m with their Eng manager next week. Also looping @sales-ops for pricing scenarios.
Iris (Enablement): I'll prepare a short checklist for the workshop: architecture review, routing policy, eval prompt set, embeddings lifecycle.
Sam (SE): Action items: 1) Capacity assessment (ops) 2) Temp quota bump (CS) 3) Workshop (Enablement) 4) Pricing sketch (AE). Who owns capacity?
Toni (CSM): @OpsBot assigned to eng-infra, Sam you own the assessment, Ops team to confirm by EOD Thursday.
OpsBot: note added to CS-4829: eng-infra oncall notified.
Alex (Account Exec): If this goes well, we should package as "CedarTech Dedicated Pilot" and include a path to Dedicated (reserved capacity). Will prep upsell bullet points.
Toni (CSM): I'll capture feedback after the pilot prompts and add to the renewal playbook. For now, marking high expansion signal. :rocket: 
Sam (SE): Thanks — ping me once we have the telemetry attached.
Iris (Enablement): I'll draft the workshop agenda and post in the ticket.
Toni (CSM): Closing loop: owners = Sam (capacity assessment), Iris (enablement), Alex (commercial). ETA: capacity assessment by Thu EOD, workshop scheduled within 10 days.
Alex (Account Exec): Great — I'll send a calendar invite.
